ETHICS COMMISSION AGENDA
  WEDNESDAY, JULY 10, 2024
  411 W. OCEAN BOULEVARD
  CIVIC CHAMBERS, 3:00 PM

Barbara A. Pollack, Chair  Margo Morales, Commissioner
Chief Coleman, Vice Chair  J. P. Shotwell, Commissioner
Raul Añorve, Commissioner  Susan Wise, Commissioner
Lani De Benedictis, Commissioner

  MEMBERS OF THE PUBLIC HAVE THE OPTION TO SUBMIT ONLINE PUBLIC COMMENTS
  AND EMAIL COMMENTS TO CITYCLERK@LONGBEACH.GOV

  PLEASE VIEW THE MEETING FROM YOUR COMPUTER, TABLET, OR SMARTPHONE
  VIA: HTTPS://LONGBEACH.PRIMEGOV.COM/PUBLIC/PORTAL?FROMIFRAME=TRUE

CALL TO ORDER

ROLL CALL

REGULAR AGENDA

1.  24-54098  Recommendation to approve the minutes for the Ethics Commission meeting of
  Wednesday, June 12, 2024.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

2.  24-54101  Recommendation to hold an election for the position of Chair and Vice Chair of the
  Ethics Commission.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

3.  24-54102  Recommendation to receive and file an update from staff to the Management
  Response and Action Plan to the 2020 Performance Audit of the City's Ethics
  Program.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

4.  24-54103  Recommendation to provide feedback to the Ad Hoc Committee on Updated
  Policies regarding the draft Ethics Ordinance proposed to date.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

  Page 1 of 4
   ETHICS COMMISSION AGENDA
  WEDNESDAY, JULY 10, 2024
  411 W. OCEAN BOULEVARD
  CIVIC CHAMBERS, 3:00 PM

5.  24-54104  Recommendation to receive and file a presentation from the Ad Hoc Committee on
  Updated Policies regarding Chapter 4.05 (“Gifts, Meals and Entertainment”) and
  Chapter 4.06 (“Outside Activities”) of the draft Ethics Ordinance.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

6.  24-54105  Recommendation to receive and file a presentation from the Ad Hoc Committee on
  the Lobbyist Ordinance regarding draft recommendations for changes to the City’s
  current lobbyist ordinance.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

7.  24-54106  Recommendation to receive and file an update from the Ad Hoc on the Authority of
  the Commission.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

8.  24-54107  Recommendation to discuss anticipated Ad Hoc Committees for upcoming
  projects; and, if appropriate, take action to dissolve, create or reauthorize Ad Hoc
  Committees.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

9.  24-54108  Recommendation to receive and file a monthly update from the Ethics Officer.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

10. 24-54109  Recommendation to discuss potential agenda items for future Commission
  meetings.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

PUBLIC COMMENT

Opportunity to address the Ethics Commission on non-agenda items. Each speaker is limited to
three minutes to make their comments unless extended by the Chair.

ANNOUNCEMENTS

ADJOURNMENT

I, Phillip McGowan, City Clerk Specialist, certify that the agenda was posted not less than 72 hours
prior to the meeting.
